lines.text: What actually happens to your body when you stop sleeping?
After just one night, your brain starts struggling to focus.
It feels like your thoughts are wading through mud,
because your brain hasn't had time to clear out the day's waste.
By forty-eight hours, your body starts playing tricks on you,
with tiny blackouts called microsleeps, where your brain just shuts off for seconds.
You won't even know it's happening.
Push past three days, and some people start seeing things that aren't there.
But here's the thing, your body will always win.
Eventually it just forces you to sleep, whether you like it or not.
